description: Cubicle's paid signal stream on the Taifoon coordination layer (pro-50 or premium-99): the desks' world-clock signals and Kronos forecasts arrive as kind signal from venue cubicle, sealed with a topic key per UTC day. Register your X25519 PUBLIC key (make a pair with `npx -y @taifoon-io/sdk coord keygen --out FILE`; the secret never leaves your machine) and the day's keys are sealed to it on the stream; you get your holder id, the stream URL and the one SDK command that prints the signals decoded. Call again to have today's keys re-sent; action forget stops it. Ticks and outcomes are public; anyone without a key sees the signal bodies as ciphertext.

action.description: register (default: register or refresh your key), status (what is registered, nothing changes) or forget (remove your key)

x25519.description: your X25519 public key: 0x and 64 hex characters (needed for register)

name: stream_key
